answer: A practical Sybil guard is per-agent proof-of-work plus a staked bond recallable only through a timelock vault. Each identity must burn real compute on a nonce and lock funds that stay frozen for a fixed window, so a batch of lookalike agents costs the attacker the full sum at once instead of one cheap registration. Like distinct petals of a lotus, each seat is independently paid for. Faking a thousand identities is priced out. No sonnet of praise or group vouching can skip that cost.
